entities.summary: Alexander Yukhymovych Sirota is a Ukrainian photographer, journalist, and filmmaker. He writes in Russian and Ukrainian. As a former resident of Pripyat, he is an eyewitness and a victim of the 1986 Chernobyl disaster. He has devoted many articles, photographs, and video reports to the city of Pripyat and to the Chernobyl catastrophe. He is the editor-in-chief of the internet project "pripyat.com" and the president of the International Public Organization "Center Pripyat.com". In May 2008, he became the winner of the ІХ-th international competition "Golden George" of films, TV-programs, and internet projects about protective law and law enforcement.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a former resident of Pripyat and eyewitness to the 1986 Chernobyl disaster, Alexander Sirota's work provides critical historical insight into one of the most significant environmental disasters of the 20th century.
